_comment: Identifiers the published page needs to ask the viewer's connectors for the
right data. None of these is a secret: they are account and campaign ids,
and every call runs on the viewer's own credentials.
If the Meta campaign is renamed, hubspot.matchValue must be updated too or
the lead cohort silently empties. The data health panel reports the cohort
size so a drop to zero is visible rather than quiet.
